name: EMAP like 4

function.text: EML4 encodes echinoderm microtubule-associated protein-like 4. Annotated molecular activities include alpha-tubulin binding and beta-tubulin binding. It participates in microtubule-based process and microtubule cytoskeleton organization.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Lung adenocarcinoma; ALK-positive histiocytosis; NTRK-rearranged spindle cell sarcoma of the uterine cervix / corpus. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: EML4 encodes echinoderm microtubule-associated protein-like 4. It is essential for the formation and stability of microtubules (MTs). It is required for the organization of the mitotic spindle and for the proper attachment of kinetochores to MTs. It promotes the recruitment of NUDC to the mitotic spindle for mitotic progression.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EML4 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, ALK-positive histiocytosis, and NTRK-rearranged spindle cell sarcoma of the uterine cervix / corpus.
